step: Inspect the existing board-health decision path in `codex-dashboard/server.js` together with the shared metrics/task-record parsing in `scripts/lib.sh`, then identify the smallest persisted-record inputs already available for deterministic retry, starvation, and low-completion queue-drain buffer behavior.

decision_path.healthy_flip_rule: A fresh strategy run is forced from `running` to `failed` only when `buildStrategyHealthGuard(...).healthy` is false.

why_needed: Scope retry and starvation checks to one project
Detect actionable active work from `status` and `execution.state`
Detect in-progress retry evidence from `execution.state`, `execution.attempt`, and `execution.max_retries`

fields: non-empty line count per project queue file
why_needed: Detect whether approved/pending backlog is actually queued
Provide recent completed multi-attempt outcomes with deterministic `attempts` data
Allow a bounded recent retry-churn signal without inventing new history storage

entrypoints: provider-stats recovery merge from registry + tasks.log
shared_task_record_parsing_in_scripts_li.note: The shared shell parsing already normalizes the same project/task keys used by the dashboard, and it also proves that retry attempts are persisted both in registry execution data and in `tasks.log` records.

retry_churn.rule: Use registry records for active churn and task-log records for recent churn. Active retry churn is already derivable when at least 1 project task is still actionable (`status in {"approved","running"}` OR `execution.state in {"running","retrying"}`) and shows retry evidence (`execution.state == "retrying"` OR (`execution.attempt > 1` AND (`execution.max_retries == 0` OR `execution.attempt <= execution.max_retries`))). Recent retry churn can be derived from project `tasks.log` records by selecting recent completed outcomes with `attempts > 1` and `result in {"SUCCESS","FAILURE"}`.
retry_churn.why_bounded: This stays within persisted per-task fields that are already loaded by `readStrategyHealth` and already written by `append_task_log_record`, so no new storage format or non-deterministic history scan is required.

queue_starvation.rule: Detect queue starvation for a project when backlog is present in persisted registry state (`pending_approval + approved > 0`), but there is no active progress (`execution.state in {"running","retrying"}` count is 0) and no queued work for the project (`queues/<project>.txt` line count is 0). Pending backlog is already counted by `buildProjectHealthMetrics`, approved backlog is already counted by the same path, and live activity is already derived by `compactQueueState`.
queue_starvation.why_bounded: This uses only existing persisted registry, queue, and runtime-status inputs, with one fixed backlog threshold of `>= 1` task across pending or approved work and no new timer-based heuristic.

hooks.rule: Seed one pending-approval task titled `Keep an executable system-work buffer when the queue drains under low completion rate` when `len(actions) < 2`, `pending_approval_creation_guard` is false, low completion is live (`total_records > 0` and `completion_rate < 0.5`) or persisted board health still requires a buffer, and `(approved_actionable_count + running_actionable_count) < SYSTEM_WORK_BUFFER_THRESHOLD`.
hooks.persisted_board_health_fallback: The same seed path also fires when persisted board health says `low_completion_drain_detected` is true, or when `retry_churn_detected` is true alongside current retry pressure and current queue starvation.
duplicate_prevention: Skip creation when `find_equivalent_seed_task(...)` finds an existing equivalent seed task for the same project.
Skip creation when failed equivalent count reaches `STRATEGY_SATURATED_FAILURE_THRESHOLD`.
hooks.status_shape: Creates a `pending_approval` task and keeps the normal approval flow via `finalize_task_for_approval(...)`.

hooks.rule: Auto-append one approved queued buffer task for `codex-agent-system` when the global `current_runnable_count = len(queue_entries) + (1 if running_entry[0] and running_entry[1] else 0)` is below `ENTERPRISE_ACTIONABLE_TARGET` and persisted `success_rate <= RECENT_COMPLETION_RATE_THRESHOLD`.
duplicate_prevention: Skip creation when `task_blocks_duplicate(...)` finds a matching actionable task in `{pending_approval, approved, running}` by title or queue-drain source identifiers.
Skip creation when failed equivalent count reaches `STRATEGY_SATURATED_FAILURE_THRESHOLD`.
hooks.rehydration_note: Approved tasks with queue handoff status `queued` or `already_queued` are deterministically re-enqueued if the live queue no longer contains them.

hooks.rule: Preserve or seed one deterministic dashboard-side follow-up task for a bounded failed plan step when executable work drained.
duplicate_prevention: Return `reason: "preserved"` when `findLowCompletionQueueDrainFollowupTask(...)` finds the existing follow-up in persisted registry state.
Treat `createTaskRegistryItem(...)` status `409` as duplicate and return `reason: "duplicate"` without creating another task.

mirrored_metric_defaults: codex-dashboard/server.js seeds `low_completion_drain_detected: false` in the metrics file bootstrap.
scripts/lib.sh seeds `low_completion_drain_detected: false` in the shared metrics default payload.
